The '''Zephyr GB-134 speeder''', also known as the '''Canto Bight Police Speeder''' the '''GB-134 pursuit craft''', or informally as '''jet-sticks''', was a pursuit [[speeder]] used by [[Canto Bight]] [[Canto Bight Police Department|Police]] [[Police officer|officers]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]].

==Characteristics==
Canto Bight's winding alleys made traditional heavy speeders unfavorable. So the local law enforcement relied upon jet-sticks. The laser cannons were normally set to stun, but could be dialed up to lethal to kill or disable. The speeders were not capable of atmospheric flight, but they could easily float over rooftops and small stretches of water.<ref name="CVNE" />
